unspecified_scores.reason: Confirmed at addons/intelligence/app/rag/file_question.py:1037-1063 (PageImages.open takes PYMUPDF_LOCK, and close releases it only after the document is closed). It shows up only when a PDF extraction or page OCR job starts while a page request renders its pages (at most 4 pages of up to 1280 px each, typically a second or two). The background indexing job is then delayed by that long, which the user does not notice.

specification_compliance: I8: every PyMuPDF call for page rendering (pymupdf.open, page access, get_pixmap, tobytes, close) runs inside the PYMUPDF_LOCK hold taken in PageImages.open and released in PageImages.close (file_question.py:1037-1063).

I7: lock acquisition is bounded by lock_seconds (PAGE_IMAGE_LOCK_SECONDS), and a timeout raises PageImageUnavailable; rendering scales the long edge to PAGE_IMAGE_LONG_EDGE (file_question.py:1003-1015).
regression_risks: Holding PYMUPDF_LOCK for a whole page request serializes the request with extraction and page OCR workers; a slow render briefly delays background indexing.
test_coverage: Did not inspect tests for the lock hold; checked only the code path in file_question.py.
not_verified: Did not check whether the caller always calls PageImages.close in a finally block on every path, including exceptions and deadlines.
Did not check the value of PAGE_IMAGE_LOCK_SECONDS or of PAGE_IMAGE_LONG_EDGE.
